selected_story.headline: Microsoft 365 Back Online After Global Outage
selected_story.source_title: Microsoft says all Microsoft 365 products are operational, ending an outage that disrupted governments, traders, hospitals, and businesses around the world (Bloomberg)

short.title: Microsoft 365 Back Online After Global Outage
short.description:
The outage paralysed critical infrastructure, including government and healthcare operations, highlighting the fragility of relying on a single, centralised authentication layer for global enterprise workflows.

short.script: Microsoft 365 Back Online After Global Outage. Microsoft confirmed that all flagship 365 applications, including Teams and Outlook, were fully restored by Saturday, November 14, following a multi-day outage that impacted over 70 countries. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
